items.title: Flood-displaced families return to Timure and set up temporary tents
items.summary: Rasuwa, November 18 People displaced by the flood in the Lhende River on August 26 have returned to their homes in Timure, Rasuwa, and begun living in temporary tents. Of the 68 displaced households, 48 people have been living in tents set up at Khaidi in Timure since November 17. items.title: Nepal urges China to reopen Tatopani border crossing
items.summary: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal tells a visiting Chinese delegation that the crossing is crucial to connectivity, as the Rasuwagadhi route remains shut following the August floods.

items.title: Flood victims occupy Nepal Electricity Authority land, erect tents
items.summary: More than 250 displaced families from Trishuli Bazar cleared the land using an excavator, accusing the government of delaying their rehabilitation.
